subject: Music Production
title: The Range of Human Hearing
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Range of Human Hearing.

hook.text: A healthy young person can hear sounds from twenty hertz up to twenty thousand hertz.

buildup.text: Below twenty hertz is infrasound, which you feel as vibration but cannot actually hear.

discovery.text: Above twenty thousand hertz is ultrasound, used by bats and dolphins but invisible to human ears.

twist.text: Most adults lose high-frequency hearing with age and cannot hear above fifteen thousand hertz.

climax.text: Producers master music with this range in mind, focusing energy where human ears are most sensitive.

punchline.text: We only hear a tiny slice of all vibrations.

quiz.question: What is the approximate upper limit of young human hearing?
